paragraphs: Curbtender builds refuse collection trucks and claims over 50 years of experience manufacturing automated side loaders. Design and manufacturing happen in Cedar Falls, Iowa and Gothenburg, Nebraska.

The company produces 13 different refuse truck models. The original Curbtender is described as the first commercially produced automated side loader in the United States waste industry. That flagship was renamed the PowerPak in 2017. Manual side loading refuse products are built as well. Rear loaders come in a full range of body sizes and performance packages, and two front loader models round out the range. On the automated side loaders, the lift arm can raise up to 2,000 pounds and comes with a standard five year structural warranty.

The assets of Wayne Industrial Holdings were purchased in 2017, when Kevin Watje was named chief executive. Curbtender Sweepers is a wholly owned subsidiary, covering grapple loaders, leaf and litter vacuums and street sweepers. The company has begun integrating its products with all electric truck chassis platforms.

quote.text: We believe in building trucks that work as hard as our customers.
